',E'
'),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS before_lf_sha256, pg_catalog.encode(extensions.digest(pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(prosrc,'errcode=''40001'',message=''CASH_DATE_VERSION_CONFLICT''','errcode=''PT409'',message=''CASH_DATE_VERSION_CONFLICT'''),'errcode=''40001'',message=''CASH_DATE_SOURCE_CHANGED''','errcode=''PT409'',message=''CASH_DATE_SOURCE_CHANGED'''),'errcode=''40001'',message=''CASH_DATE_PROPOSAL_CHANGED''','errcode=''PT409'',message=''CASH_DATE_PROPOSAL_CHANGED'''),'errcode=''40001'',message=''SOURCE_BASIS_CHANGED''','errcode=''PT409'',message=''SOURCE_BASIS_CHANGED'''),E'
',E'
'),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS proposed_recipe_after_lf_sha256 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='api' AND p.proname IN ('wave5_cash_date_command','wave5_cash_save_v2') ORDER BY proname
